main_text.l: sti oratio, de nostri abnegatione, & sequela Christi. Prior locus habet i Miraculum sana-ti hydropici. ii monet de modestia in accumbendo, v. 7. iii docet qui sint vocandi ad conuiuia.v. 12. denique utili anagoge hac omnia ad vitam æter-nam transfert: indicans inprimis operam esse dan-dam ne nostro vitio ab illo caelesti conuiuio excluda-mur. v. 15.

Cap. xv. Publicanis & peccatoribus ad Christum confluentibus, murmurant hypocri-tæ, rem Christo indignam iudicantes, damnant-que in ipso Christo patientiam. Hinc Christo opus est apologia: ut ostendat iustè se admit-tere peccatores. Quod factum tuetur triplici pa-rabola, prima est de oue perdita, usque ad v. 8. Secunda de drachma perdita & inuenta, usque ad v. 11. tertia de filio perdito.

page.notes: The left strip shows the outer edge of the facing page (p. 92) with marginal text. It belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The bold italic lines "Secunda ... tertia ... perdito" are set centred and are read here as the continuation of the same sentence. The printed "Quinque" at lower right is the catchword.
